finding.rationale: Calls ftCommon_8007D5D4, enters motion_state + 7 with flags 0, freezes animation, and calls ftCo_800CB110(gobj, true, 1). HeavyWait1_Anim invokes it after the cargo jump startup countdown expires. The CargoJump entry analog performs the same +7 transition and initialization. Together these support jump entry rather than fall entry despite its location in heavyfall.c. Exact original naming is not established, and the downstream helper's complete effects were not independently traced.
